title: BACE: code and derived data for "Evidence-grounded reliability of AI-generated sustainability disclosures"

creators.name: Wang, Muchen
creators.affiliation: Department of Environmental System Sciences, ETH Zurich

creators.name: Chapman, Melissa
creators.affiliation: Department of Environmental System Sciences, ETH Zurich

description:
Code, frozen configurations, prompts and response schemas for Bidirectional Atomic Claim Evaluation (BACE), together with the derived data of the main experiment: 1,800 AI-generated sustainability disclosures for 30 European companies, five target reporting years and 12 ESRS-style disclosure tasks, their disclosure and evidence claim sets, accepted support sets, unsupported-claim diagnoses, comparator (RAGChecker, RAGAS) claim verdicts and disclosure-level metrics.

Source code is licensed under the MIT License (LICENSE). Derived data and results are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (DATA_LICENSE.md). The annual and sustainability reports and structured ESG indicators used as source evidence come from the Corporate Sustainability Tracker and are not redistributed.
